data.one_liner: Run linters and custom commands on git staged files for Flutter and Dart projects
data.what_it_does: Runs arbitrary shell commands and linters on a subset of git staged files matched by glob patterns before a commit. It supports backing up uncommitted changes via git stash and can be used as a pre-commit git hook or via Dart code.
use_when: You want to automatically run code formatters or linters like dart format on staged files before committing
You want to prevent errors and ensure code style consistency in git commits
avoid_when: You want to lint the entire project repository instead of only staged files
You are not using git for version control
strengths: Speeds up linting by only checking files that are about to be committed
Supports custom glob pattern matching for file filtering
Provides built-in backup stashing and error recovery
weaknesses: Requires manual configuration of git hooks (such as using Husky)
Behavior depends on external git commands and local executable environments
data.setup_notes: Add as a dev dependency via pub add, configure rules in pubspec.yaml, and set up git hooks using a tool like husky.
